title: Willow Consulate
description: A light upper voice leaves spaces for a nimble bassoon-like reply. Two unequal conversations lead to a minor-coloured central duet, then the upper voice takes over the bass rhythm. The final exchange gathers into a bright chord rather than dissolving.
technical_note: Keep the paired compound beats elastic and the lower replies articulate. Upper held tones and bass eighth notes need different touch. The short ascending gestures are prepared by rests; the final chord retains the pulse.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
